summary: Released 30 September 2025, covering April 2023 to April 2024, and still the latest edition as of 6 October 2026. PaNS Wales is the named metric source for SI10 (population acting on the crises) and feeds SI7 use-of-greenspace evidence, so each edition is the baseline refresh for those indicators. The gov.wales release page gives the next edition as scheduled for November 2026.
